# Labels

> **Purpose:** Define the standard label set used on issues and pull requests.
> **Audience:** All contributors.
> **Last Updated:** 2026-08-07
> **Version:** 1.0.0
> **Author:** Adrian Cioanca (acebio)
> **Related Documents:** [../CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md), [ISSUE_TEMPLATE/](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/)

---

## Type

| Label | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `bug` | Something isn't working as expected |
| `enhancement` | New feature or improvement |
| `docs` | Documentation only |
| `chore` | Tooling, dependencies, config |
| `question` | Needs discussion/clarification, not yet actionable |

## Priority

| Label | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `P0-critical` | Blocking; drop other work |
| `P1-high` | Should be done this sprint |
| `P2-medium` | Could slip a sprint |
| `P3-low` | Backlog / opportunistic |

## Area

| Label | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `area-backend` | FastAPI backend |
| `area-frontend` | React/TypeScript frontend |
| `area-ai-agents` | Agent implementation/behaviour |
| `area-prompts` | Prompt library |
| `area-architecture` | Architecture/ADR |
| `area-devops` | CI/CD, Docker, tooling |
| `area-docs` | Documentation |

## Status

| Label | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `status-blocked` | Cannot proceed — see comments for blocker |
| `status-needs-review` | Awaiting review |
| `status-good-first-issue` | Suitable for a new contributor |

## Applying labels

Type + one priority label are expected on every issue/PR at minimum. Area labels are added by whoever triages (or the author, if confident). See [../CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
